title: fMRIflow Artifact Hub store manifest (hub.json)
description: Root-level index of a hub store git repository. fMRIflow reads this to know what artifacts exist and which files back them.

schema.description: Manifest schema version. Current supported version is 1.

kind.description: Artifact kind. Determines the local install destination.

name.description: Identifier fMRIflow shows for this kind (config filename, module name, error id, heuristic name, ...). Unique within a kind.

files.description: Repo-relative paths (under kinds/<kind>/) backing this artifact, incl. sidecars.

sha256.description: Combined content hash of files (verified on install; install is rejected on mismatch).

lfs.description: True when the file(s) are git-LFS tracked (feature_array blobs).

metadata.description: Kind-specific extras. module entries MUST include 'category'.
